channel.title: LulzTigre // Phantom Research Kernel
channel.description: Stealth research blog exploring mechanistic interpretability, distributed consensus, and zero-knowledge cryptography.

item.title: GrandScream: From One Desk Phone to a Root PBX
item.description: Recon methodology and chain automation: one unauthenticated request against a Grandstream GXP phone becomes a root shell on the UCM PBX. Blind-oracle SQLi, credential reuse graphs, and the stdlib-only script that automates every handoff.

item.title: Deconstructing Induction Heads and Attention Routing in Deep Transformer Circuits
item.description: An empirical analysis into how two-layer attention compositions implement in-context pattern matching, with eigenvalue decomposition of W_OV and W_QK circuits.

item.title: Optimistic Fast-Paths in Asynchronous Byzantine Fault-Tolerant State Machine Replication
item.description: Analyzing optimistic super-quorums to drop consensus commit latency from 3Δ to 2Δ under partial synchrony regimes.

item.title: Polynomial Commitment Schemes: KZG vs FRI in Recursive Verifiable Computation
item.description: A comparative study on proof size, verifier arithmetic complexity, and trusted setup assumptions between KZG and FRI in recursive zero-knowledge systems.
